title_tag: 平陆运河终于通了：中国等了 100 年，为什么这条运河“非挖不可”？—— 香港《南华早报》外刊讲解第1172天
h1: 平陆运河终于通了：中国等了 100 年，为什么这条运河“非挖不可”？
category: 香港《南华早报》外刊讲解 第1172天
nav_hint: China launches new canal, first of its kind since 1949

headline.en_html: China launches new canal, first of its kind since 1949, giving inland access to sea lanes — Newly opened Pinglu Canal will allow cargo from inland provinces to reach the Gulf of Tonkin, avoiding a 560km detour, deepening trade ties
headline.zh: 中国启用新运河，为 1949 年以来首条，内陆自此直通海上航道——新通航的平陆运河将使内陆省份货物直抵北部湾，免去 560 公里绕行，进一步密切贸易往来

notes.en: launch (v.) means to start something new, or to set something in motion for the first time
notes.zh: 正式启用，使（工程、项目）开始运行；推出
notes.ctx: 本义是“把长矛猛力掷出”，用在这条运河上指 9 月 16 日正式启用、第一次投入实际通航——不是“开工”，也不是“建成”，而是“开始跑船”。
notes.ex1: The carmaker will launch three electric models in Southeast Asia next quarter. 这家车企将于下季度在东南亚推出三款电动车型。
notes.ex2: The shipyard launched its largest container vessel after two years of construction. 经过两年建造，这家船厂让其最大的集装箱船下水。

notes.en: first of its kind means the first example ever of a particular type of thing
notes.ctx: 标题里紧跟 since 1949，说的是 1949 年以来第一条连江通海的人工水道——“首例”是七十余年的时间跨度撑起来的，不是修辞。
notes.ex1: The deal is the first of its kind between a Chinese chipmaker and a European carmaker. 这笔交易是中国芯片厂商与欧洲车企之间的首例合作。
notes.ex2: Regulators approved a first-of-its-kind licence for autonomous cargo ships. 监管机构批准了一张针对无人货船的首例牌照。

notes.en: a sea lane is a route regularly used by ships crossing the ocean
notes.ctx: lane 是“车道”，sea lane 就是海上的车道；此处指内陆货船经运河接入的、通往东南亚与全球市场的远洋干线。
notes.ex1: Nearly a third of global trade passes through a handful of busy sea lanes. 全球近三分之一的贸易要经由少数几条繁忙的海上航道。
notes.ex2: Insurance costs rise sharply whenever a key sea lane becomes unsafe. 只要一条关键航道变得不安全，保险成本就会急剧上升。

notes.en: a detour is a longer route taken in order to avoid something or to reach a place indirectly
notes.ctx: de-（离开）+ tour（转），指绕开正路多转一圈；文中指通航前西南货物必须经广州出海、白走约 560 公里的那段冤枉路。
notes.ex1: Drivers took a two-hour detour after the bridge was closed for repairs. 大桥封闭维修后，司机们绕行了两个小时。
notes.ex2: Shipping firms want to avoid the costly detour around the southern cape. 航运公司希望避开绕行南端海角那段代价高昂的路线。

paragraphs.en_html: China officially opened its <mark class="voc">landmark</mark> Pinglu Canal to <mark class="voc">navigation</mark> on Wednesday, creating a new <mark class="voc">maritime</mark> gateway for the country’s southwestern <mark class="voc">hinterland</mark> and providing a shorter route to Southeast Asia as Beijing <mark class="voc">seeks to</mark> deepen trade with the region. The 134.2km (83.4 mile) <mark class="voc">waterway</mark> links Nanning, the capital of the southern region of Guangxi, to the Gulf of Tonkin, known as the Beibu Gulf in China, allowing <mark class="voc">cargo</mark> from inland provinces to reach the sea without taking a roughly 560km detour <mark class="voc">via</mark> Guangzhou, cutting both <mark class="voc">transit</mark> times and <mark class="voc">logistics</mark> costs.
paragraphs.zh: 中国于周三正式宣告平陆运河通航。这项标志性工程为中国西南腹地开辟出一道全新的出海门户，也为通往东南亚铺就了一条更短的路径——而此时，中国正着力深化与该地区的经贸往来。这条全长134.2公里（83.4英里）的水道，将广西首府南宁与北部湾（国际上称东京湾）连为一体。自此，内陆省份的货物不必再取道广州、平白绕行约560公里，便可直抵大海，运输时间与物流成本由此双双下降。

notes.en: landmark (adj.) means marking an important stage or turning point in something's development
notes.zh: 里程碑式的，标志性的；地标
notes.ctx: land（陆地）+ mark（标记），原指辨认方位的显著建筑；文中形容这条运河是中国内河航运史上一道分界线式的工程。
notes.ex1: The court issued a landmark ruling on cross-border data transfers. 法院就跨境数据传输作出了一项里程碑式的裁定。
notes.ex2: Investors called the merger a landmark deal for the semiconductor industry. 投资者称这次合并是半导体行业的一桩标志性交易。

notes.en: navigation means the movement of ships or other vessels through water, or the process of directing their course
notes.ctx: 词根 navi-（船），open to navigation 即“开放通航”——水道从此具备让船舶正常往来的条件，此前只做过试航。
notes.ex1: The river reopened to navigation once the water level stabilised. 水位稳定后，这条河重新开放通航。
notes.ex2: Poor visibility forced the port to suspend navigation for two days. 能见度太差，港口被迫停航两天。

notes.en: maritime means connected with the sea, especially in relation to shipping, trade or navigation
notes.ctx: 词根 mar-（海），与 marine、submarine 同源；文中指运河为西南腹地开出的那个“出海门户”，即让内陆第一次直接接上海运体系。
notes.ex1: The city has grown into a maritime hub linking three continents. 这座城市已发展成连接三大洲的海运枢纽。
notes.ex2: New maritime rules require cleaner fuel on all coastal routes. 新的海事规定要求所有沿海航线使用更清洁的燃料。

notes.en: hinterland means the inland area lying behind a coast or a port, which the port serves
notes.ctx: 德语 hinter（后面）+ land（地），指港口背后那片不临海、却要靠它出海的内陆；文中即云贵川渝等省。
notes.ex1: The port owes much of its growth to a booming industrial hinterland. 这座港口的增长很大程度上得益于蓬勃发展的工业腹地。
notes.ex2: Rail links were built to pull cargo from the western hinterland. 修建铁路是为了把西部腹地的货源吸引过来。

notes.en: seek to do something means to make an effort or attempt to achieve it
notes.ctx: 本义“寻找”，用在政策语境是“着力谋求”：北京正力图深化与东南亚的贸易，这条运河就是这份努力的一部分。
notes.ex1: The company is seeking to expand its footprint across Southeast Asia. 该公司正谋求扩大其在东南亚的布局。
notes.ex2: Regulators are seeking to reduce the cost of cross-border payments. 监管机构正力图降低跨境支付成本。

notes.en: a waterway is a river, canal or other channel of water that ships can travel along
notes.ctx: water（水）+ way（路），即水上的路；文中指全长 134.2 公里的运河本身，也统称各省在扩建的内河航道网。
notes.ex1: China is investing heavily in upgrading its inland waterways. 中国正大举投资升级内河航道。
notes.ex2: The waterway can handle barges of up to 3,000 tonnes. 这条水道可通行3000吨级的驳船。

notes.en: cargo means the goods carried by a ship, aircraft or other vehicle
notes.ctx: 本义“装载之物”，指运输途中的大宗货物；文中指内陆省份原本要绕道广州才能出海的那批货。
notes.ex1: The vessel was carrying a cargo of machinery bound for Vietnam. 这艘船装载着一批运往越南的机械设备。
notes.ex2: Delays at the port left thousands of tonnes of cargo waiting to be cleared. 港口延误导致数千吨货物滞留待清关。

notes.en: via means by way of a particular place, or by means of a particular method
notes.ctx: 拉丁语 via 就是“路”，作介词表示经由某地中转；文中指通航前那条绕不开的路线——广州。
notes.ex1: Most of the cargo used to reach the sea via ports in Guangdong. 过去大部分货物都要经广东的港口出海。
notes.ex2: Payments are now settled via a digital clearing platform. 如今款项通过数字清算平台结算。

notes.en: transit means the process of being moved or transported from one place to another
notes.ctx: trans-（跨越）+ it（走），指货物在路上的那段运输与中转过程；cutting transit times 即压缩在途时间。
notes.ex1: Cutting transit time by two days gives exporters a real advantage. 把在途时间缩短两天，给出口商带来了实实在在的优势。
notes.ex2: The goods were damaged in transit and had to be replaced. 货物在运输途中受损，只得重新发货。

notes.en: logistics means the detailed organisation of moving goods, people or supplies from one place to another
notes.ctx: 原是军事术语“后勤”，指把粮草弹药准确送到前线；用到商业上，就是货物流转的整套组织与成本体系。
notes.ex1: Rising fuel prices have pushed logistics costs to a five-year high. 燃油价格上涨把物流成本推到了五年来的高点。
notes.ex2: The company built a regional logistics hub to serve Southeast Asia. 该公司建了一个区域物流枢纽，服务东南亚市场。

paragraphs.en_html: With a planned investment of 72.7 billion yuan (US$10.8 billion), the project, which began construction in August 2022, is designed to <mark class="voc">accommodate</mark> <mark class="voc">vessels</mark> of up to 5,000 <mark class="voc">tonnes</mark> and save more than 5 billion yuan in <mark class="voc">overall</mark> transportation costs each year.
paragraphs.zh: 该工程计划投资727亿元人民币（约合108亿美元），自2022年8月动工，按设计可通行5000吨级船舶，每年可节省各类运输成本逾50亿元。

notes.en: accommodate means to provide enough space for someone or something, or to adapt to someone's needs
notes.zh: 容纳，接纳；（规格上）承接得住
notes.ctx: ac-（使）+ commodus（合适），本义“容得下”；文中指运河按设计可通行最大 5000 吨级船舶——是规格上真的装得下，不是“大概能过”。
notes.ex1: The upgraded terminal can accommodate ships twice the previous size. 升级后的码头可停靠体量翻倍的船舶。
notes.ex2: We will try to accommodate your delivery schedule. 我们会尽量配合你们的交付时间安排。

notes.en: a vessel is a ship or large boat; it can also mean a container, or a tube carrying blood in the body
notes.zh: 船舶（正式用语）；容器；血管
notes.ctx: 本义“容器”——船就是漂在水上的大容器；在航运文本里比 ship 正式，多用于规格、法规与统计场合。
notes.ex1: Only vessels meeting the new safety standard may enter the channel. 只有符合新安全标准的船舶才可驶入航道。
notes.ex2: Three vessels were held at anchor pending customs clearance. 三艘船在锚地待命，等待清关。

notes.en: a tonne is a metric unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms
notes.ctx: 与美制 ton（短吨，约 907 公斤）不是一回事；文中“5000 吨级”是衡量船舶载重与货运量的标准单位。
notes.ex1: The port handled 180 million tonnes of cargo last year. 这座港口去年吞吐货物1.8亿吨。
notes.ex2: A 5,000-tonne vessel can carry the load of about 250 heavy trucks. 一艘5000吨级船舶的载货量约相当于250辆重型卡车。

notes.en: overall means taking everything into account; total rather than partial
notes.ctx: over（覆盖）+ all（全部），指各项加总之后的总数；文中那 50 亿元是各类运输成本合计后的节省额。
notes.ex1: Overall costs fell even though fuel prices rose. 尽管油价上涨，总成本仍然下降了。
notes.ex2: Overall, the quarter was stronger than analysts expected. 总的来说，这个季度好于分析师预期。

paragraphs.en_html: The canal is the first <mark class="voc">man-made</mark> waterway connecting a river to the sea to be built since the founding of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, <mark class="voc">state-run</mark> Xinhua News Agency reported. Some <mark class="voc">observers</mark> have <mark class="voc">described it as</mark> the country’s most significant canal <mark class="voc">undertaking</mark> since the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, and it forms a key link in the New International Land-Sea Trade <mark class="voc">Corridor</mark>. It is <mark class="voc">equipped with</mark> a <mark class="voc">tiered</mark> navigation zone system to <mark class="voc">facilitate</mark> the movement of <mark class="voc">inland</mark> vessels, allowing <mark class="voc">qualified</mark> vessels to travel through the canal and into the sea without <mark class="voc">transferring</mark> cargo to another ship.
paragraphs.zh: 据官方媒体新华社报道，这是1949年新中国成立以来，中国建成的第一条连江通海的人工水道。一些观察人士称之为继京杭大运河之后中国最重大的运河工程，它也构成了西部陆海新通道中的关键一环。运河配备梯级通航系统，便利内河船舶通行——达标船舶可一路穿越运河、直驶入海，全程无需换船转货。

notes.en: man-made means created by people rather than occurring in nature
notes.ctx: 与天然河道相对；文中强调运河不是现成的河，而是硬挖出来的——“1949 年以来第一条”的分量，正落在这三个字上。
notes.ex1: The reservoir is a man-made lake built for flood control. 这座水库是为防洪修建的人工湖。
notes.ex2: Engineers dug a man-made channel through the ridge. 工程师们在山脊上开凿出一条人工水道。

notes.en: state-run means owned and operated by the government rather than by private owners
notes.ctx: run 在此是“经营、运作”；这是按国际新闻惯例标注信息来源的官方属性——新华社是国家通讯社，中性标签，不带褒贬。
notes.ex1: The report was first carried by state-run television. 这则报道最先由官方电视台播出。
notes.ex2: Several state-run firms have joined the port expansion. 多家国有企业参与了港口扩建。

notes.en: an observer is a person who watches and comments on a particular situation or field
notes.ctx: 新闻里用来引述一种普遍看法、却不指明具体机构的角色；证据强度弱于海关数据这类硬统计，读时要打个折扣。
notes.ex1: Some observers doubt the target can be met on time. 一些观察人士怀疑这一目标能否按时实现。
notes.ex2: Industry observers expect freight rates to fall next year. 业内观察人士预计明年运价会下降。

notes.en: to describe something as something means to say what you think it is or what it is like
notes.zh: 把 A 称为/描述为 B
notes.ctx: 表达的是说话人的判断，不是事实认定；文中“观察人士称其为京杭之后最重大”，是评价而非官方定论。
notes.ex1: Analysts described the deal as a turning point for the sector. 分析人士称这笔交易是该行业的转折点。
notes.ex2: The canal has been described as the country's boldest waterway project in decades. 这条运河被称为中国数十年来最大胆的水道工程。

notes.en: an undertaking is a task or project, especially a large, difficult or ambitious one
notes.ctx: under（在下）+ take（拿），即“扛到自己肩上的事”；文中指耗资 727 亿元、要凿穿分水岭的这项浩大工程。
notes.ex1: Rebuilding the delta's flood defences is a costly undertaking. 重建三角洲的防洪体系是一项耗资巨大的工程。
notes.ex2: The two firms treated the expansion as a joint undertaking. 两家公司把这次扩建当作一项共同事业来推进。

notes.en: a corridor is a long passage connecting places; in trade it means a strip of territory used as a route
notes.ctx: 本义“供人跑动的长通道”，区域经济里指把多个地区串起来的运输走廊；文中指西部陆海新通道。
notes.ex1: The rail line forms part of a wider economic corridor. 这条铁路是更大范围经济走廊的一部分。
notes.ex2: Planners left a green corridor for animals to cross the highway. 规划者留出了一条绿色廊道，供动物穿越高速公路。

notes.en: to be equipped with something means to be provided with the tools, systems or facilities needed
notes.ctx: equip 原指为船只配齐装备；文中指运河沿线设有马道、企石、青年三处梯级枢纽构成的通航系统。
notes.ex1: Each lock is equipped with an automatic water-level control system. 每座船闸都配有自动水位控制系统。
notes.ex2: The vessel is equipped with satellite navigation and sonar. 这艘船配备了卫星导航和声呐设备。

notes.en: tiered means arranged in a series of levels or stages, one above another
notes.ctx: tier 是“一层、一级”；文中指用三处枢纽的船闸把船一级一级抬过分水岭（最高处海拔约 65 米），再逐级放回海平面。
notes.ex1: The company introduced tiered pricing for different cargo volumes. 该公司针对不同货量推出了分级定价。
notes.ex2: A tiered lock system lifts vessels over the ridge in stages. 梯级船闸系统分段把船舶抬过山脊。

notes.en: facilitate means to make an action or process easier or smoother
notes.ctx: 词根 facil-（容易），即“让流程少些磕绊”；文中指梯级系统让内河船不必中途卸货就能过落差段。
notes.ex1: The agreement is designed to facilitate trade between the two blocs. 该协议旨在便利两大集团之间的贸易。
notes.ex2: Digital paperwork facilitates faster customs clearance. 电子单证使清关速度更快。

notes.en: inland means situated in the interior of a country, away from the coast
notes.ctx: in（在内）+ land（陆地），指不临海、出海必须借道的地区；文中指云贵川渝湘等省，也指跑在这些河段上的船。
notes.ex1: Inland provinces have long paid more to reach export markets. 内陆省份长期以来出口成本更高。
notes.ex2: An inland port allows customs procedures to be done before goods reach the coast. 内陆港让货物到海边之前就能完成通关手续。

notes.en: qualified means having met the necessary conditions, standards or requirements
notes.ctx: 出自 quality（标准），工程准入语境里指吨位、尺寸达到通航规格；达标的船一路穿河入海，不达标的只能另想办法。
notes.ex1: Only qualified vessels may pass through without unloading. 只有达标船舶才可不卸货直接通过。
notes.ex2: Applicants must be qualified under the new licensing rules. 申请者必须符合新的牌照规定。

notes.en: transfer means to move someone or something from one place, vehicle or account to another
notes.ctx: trans-（跨越）+ fer（带），指把货从一条船倒到另一条船；江海直达之后这道换装工序被取消，省时省钱正在这里。
notes.ex1: Goods no longer need to be transferred to a second ship at the port. 货物不必再在港口转装到第二条船上。
notes.ex2: Each transfer adds cost, delay and the risk of damage. 每一次换装都会增加成本、延误和货损风险。

paragraphs.en_html: The canal’s opening <mark class="voc">comes after</mark> <mark class="voc">a series of</mark> navigation tests. In mid-August, four <mark class="voc">merchant</mark> vessels <mark class="voc">ranging from</mark> 1,000 to 5,000 tonnes conducted <mark class="voc">phased</mark> trials along the canal’s main <mark class="voc">channel</mark>, testing the safety and reliability of the waterway, <mark class="voc">locks</mark>, <mark class="voc">anchorages</mark> and service areas, state media reported. Earlier that month, a maritime <mark class="voc">patrol</mark> vessel completed the first full-route transit test along the waterway, according to the canal’s <mark class="voc">operator</mark>. Late in August, the canal’s first command and management vessel was delivered to <mark class="voc">oversee</mark> navigation and handle <mark class="voc">emergency responses</mark> along the waterway.
paragraphs.zh: 运河的通航，是在一连串试航测试之后才最终实现的。据官方媒体报道，八月中旬，四艘1000吨至5000吨不等的商船沿主航道分阶段试航，检验了航道、船闸、锚地与服务区的安全性与可靠性。运河运营方表示，当月早些时候，一艘海事巡逻船已完成首次全线通航测试。八月下旬，运河首艘指挥管理船交付，负责统筹沿线通航调度与应急处置。

notes.w: come after / come as / come ahead of
notes.en: to come after/as/ahead of something means to happen following, during, or just before that thing
notes.zh: 在……之后／正当……之际／赶在……之前
notes.ctx: 新闻里把事件钉在时间轴上的三个介词搭配；文中 come after 指通航是“一连串试航之后”才最终实现的。
notes.ex1: The announcement came after months of quiet negotiation. 这项宣布是在数月低调谈判之后作出的。
notes.ex2: The launch came just ahead of the industry's biggest trade fair. 此次发布恰好赶在业内最大展会开幕之前。

notes.en: a series of means a number of similar events or things coming one after another
notes.ctx: series 单复数同形；文中指巡逻船跑完全线、四艘商船分段试航、指挥船交付这一连串动作。
notes.ex1: A series of trials confirmed the channel was safe for loaded vessels. 一系列试航确认航道可安全通行重载船舶。
notes.ex2: The port suffered a series of delays during the typhoon season. 台风季期间，这座港口接连遭遇延误。

notes.en: a merchant is a person or company that buys and sells goods, especially in large quantities
notes.ctx: 词根 merc-（货物），与 commerce、merchandise 同源；merchant vessel 即商船，区别于军用、公务用船。
notes.ex1: Four merchant ships were chosen to test the new channel. 四艘商船被选中试航这条新航道。
notes.ex2: The merchant fleet has expanded rapidly over the past decade. 过去十年间商船队伍迅速扩大。

notes.en: to range from one thing to another means to vary between two stated limits
notes.zh: 从 A 到 B 不等
notes.ctx: 指在一个区间内分布、涵盖中间各档；文中四艘试航船的吨位从 1000 吨到 5000 吨不等。
notes.ex1: Container fees range from fifty to three hundred dollars per box. 每个集装箱的费用从五十美元到三百美元不等。
notes.ex2: The firm sells products ranging from packaging film to medical devices. 该公司产品从包装膜一直做到医疗器械。

notes.en: phased means carried out in separate stages rather than all at once
notes.ctx: phase 是“阶段”；文中强调试航不是一次跑完全程，而是沿主航道分段分批推进，好逐段核验安全。
notes.ex1: The upgrade will be introduced in a phased rollout over two years. 此次升级将在两年内分阶段推出。
notes.ex2: The country plans to phase out older diesel trucks by 2030. 该国计划到2030年逐步淘汰老旧柴油卡车。

notes.en: a channel is a passage along which water, signals, goods or information can flow
notes.ctx: 本义“让东西流过去的通道”；main channel 即主航道，是水中划定给船舶行驶的那条路径。
notes.ex1: Dredging kept the main channel deep enough for loaded ships. 疏浚工程使主航道保持足够深度以通行重载船。
notes.ex2: The brand sells through three separate distribution channels. 该品牌通过三条不同的分销渠道销售。

notes.en: a lock is a section of a canal or river, closed off by gates at both ends, used to raise or lower boats between different water levels
notes.ctx: 船进闸室、前后闸门关闭，被“锁”在里面等水位升降——用“锁”这个熟词指“水上台阶”，是本文最该留意的僻义。
notes.ex1: Vessels wait in the lock while the water level slowly rises. 船舶在闸室中等待，水位缓缓升高。
notes.ex2: A double-line lock allows two ships to pass at the same time. 双线船闸可让两艘船同时通过。

notes.en: an anchorage is an area of water where ships can safely drop anchor and wait
notes.ctx: anchor（锚）+-age（场所），指供船待闸、待泊的专用水域；与“锚”有关，但说的是地方，不是动作。
notes.ex1: Ships waiting to enter the lock queue at a nearby anchorage. 等待过闸的船舶在附近锚地排队。
notes.ex2: Storms forced a dozen vessels to remain at anchorage overnight. 风暴迫使十余艘船在锚地滞留一夜。

notes.en: a patrol is a journey made by a person or vehicle around an area in order to watch over it
notes.ctx: 本义“来回巡查”；文中指八月上旬跑完首次全线通航测试的那艘海事巡逻船。
notes.ex1: A patrol vessel made the first full run along the waterway. 一艘巡逻船完成了沿该水道的首次全程航行。
notes.ex2: Coast guard boats patrol the estuary around the clock. 海警船全天候在入海口巡逻。

notes.en: an operator is a company or person that runs a business, service or piece of equipment
notes.ctx: 指实际经营管理设施的公司，区别于出资方 investor 与施工方 contractor；文中即运河的运营单位。
notes.ex1: The canal's operator confirmed that trials had been completed. 运河运营方确认试航已全部完成。
notes.ex2: The port operator plans to add two deep-water berths next year. 港口运营方计划明年新增两个深水泊位。

notes.en: oversee means to watch over and be responsible for work or an operation
notes.ctx: over（在上）+ see（看），从上方盯着；注意与 overlook（忽略）意思相反——一个是盯着，一个是看漏了。
notes.ex1: A new team was set up to oversee daily traffic along the canal. 新组建的团队负责统筹运河的日常通航调度。
notes.ex2: She oversees logistics for the group's twelve regional warehouses. 她负责监管集团十二个区域仓库的物流。

notes.en: emergency response means the actions taken to deal quickly with a dangerous or unexpected situation
notes.ctx: 指突发事故的现场处置机制；文中指指挥管理船除调度外，还要管船舶故障、货物落水这类急事。
notes.ex1: The vessel handles emergency response along the entire route. 这艘船负责全线的应急处置。
notes.ex2: Faster emergency response cut accident losses by a third. 更快的应急响应使事故损失减少了三分之一。

paragraphs.en_html: <mark class="voc">Beyond</mark> the engineering work, the project has also involved efforts to limit its <mark class="voc">environmental impact</mark>. At the Qingnian navigation <mark class="voc">hub</mark>, engineers built a <mark class="voc">dedicated</mark> fish <mark class="voc">passage</mark> of more than 480 metres, containing 120 pools, to help <mark class="voc">aquatic</mark> <mark class="voc">species</mark> <mark class="voc">navigate</mark> a water-level difference of nearly 10 metres, with a separate route designed for <mark class="voc">eels</mark> and other climbing species. Builders also <mark class="voc">relocated</mark> thousands of mature <mark class="voc">mangrove</mark> trees along the route and have since planted hundreds of thousands of new ones to <mark class="voc">offset</mark> the <mark class="voc">disruption</mark> to local <mark class="voc">ecosystems</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 除工程建设本身之外，这一项目还投入了大量心力，以尽可能减小它对环境的扰动。在青年枢纽，工程师专门修筑了一条480余米、含120级水池的鱼道，帮助水生生物翻越近10米的水位落差；另辟一条通道，专为鳗鱼等善于攀爬的物种而设。施工方还沿线迁移了数千棵成年红树，此后补种新树数十万棵，以弥补工程对当地生态系统造成的扰动。

notes.en: beyond means further than; in addition to something already mentioned
notes.ctx: 行文上的转身信号：从“工程本身”转向“工程之外”的生态保护，全文视角在这里换了一口气。
notes.ex1: Beyond the cost savings, the project brings new jobs to the region. 除了省下的成本，这个项目还给该地区带来了新岗位。
notes.ex2: The damage to the older locks was beyond repair. 老旧船闸的损坏已无法修复。

notes.en: environmental impact means the effect that a project or activity has on the natural surroundings
notes.ctx: 工程审批语境里对应中文“环评”；文中指运河开工前先做完评价，施工中再用鱼道、移树把影响压下来。
notes.ex1: The project could not start until the environmental impact assessment was approved. 环评通过之后，项目才得以开工。
notes.ex2: Planners redesigned the route to limit its environmental impact. 规划者重新设计了路线，以减小环境影响。

notes.en: a hub is a central point from which many things radiate outwards, such as a centre of activity or transport
notes.ctx: 本义“轮毂”，所有辐条由此向外伸展；文中指青年枢纽，三大梯级枢纽之一，鱼道就修在这里。
notes.ex1: The city has grown into a logistics hub for the whole region. 这座城市已成为整个区域的物流枢纽。
notes.ex2: Each navigation hub includes locks, a spillway and a power station. 每个通航枢纽都包含船闸、泄洪闸和电站。

notes.en: dedicated means designed for one particular purpose only; it can also mean devoted and hard-working
notes.ctx: 本义“完全奉献给一件事”；文中指那条只为鱼修建的鱼道——不承担通航，也不承担泄洪，只让鱼通过。
notes.ex1: A dedicated lane was reserved for container trucks only. 一条专用车道只留给集装箱卡车通行。
notes.ex2: She is a dedicated engineer who has spent twelve years on the project. 她是一位敬业的工程师，在这个项目上投入了十二年。

notes.en: a passage is a long narrow way that allows movement from one place to another
notes.ctx: 来自 pass（通过）；文中指 480 多米长、含 120 级水池的鱼道，另有一条专给鳗鱼的通道。
notes.ex1: The fish passage reconnected waters that had been cut off for decades. 这条鱼道重新接通了中断数十年的水域。
notes.ex2: Workers cleared a narrow passage through the reeds. 工人们在芦苇丛中清出一条狭窄通道。

notes.en: aquatic means living or growing in water, or connected with water
notes.ctx: 词根 aqua（水），与 aquarium、aqueduct 同源；文中指要翻越近 10 米落差的那些鱼与其他水生物种。
notes.ex1: Dams often block the routes that aquatic species depend on. 水坝常常阻断水生物种赖以生存的通道。
notes.ex2: Monitoring showed more than ten aquatic species using the passage. 监测显示有十多种水生生物使用了这条通道。

notes.en: a species is a group of living organisms that can breed with one another
notes.ctx: one species、ten species 拼写不变；文中指走鱼道的十余种鱼，以及需要单独通道的攀爬型物种。
notes.ex1: More than ten species were recorded moving through the passage. 有十多个物种被记录通过了这条通道。
notes.ex2: The wetland supports several endangered bird species. 这片湿地养育着数种濒危鸟类。

notes.en: navigate means to find a way through a difficult route, place or situation
notes.ctx: 本义“驾船”，引申为“费力穿过某段难走的路”；文中指鱼要借分级水池一级一级越过近 10 米落差。
notes.ex1: Small firms struggle to navigate the new customs rules. 小企业难以应付新的海关规定。
notes.ex2: The pools let fish navigate the drop in short, easy steps. 这些水池让鱼可以分成一小级一小级地越过落差。

notes.en: an eel is a long, snake-like fish that can move over wet surfaces as well as swim
notes.ctx: 幼鳗靠贴着湿滑表面往上爬，跳级式台阶对它无效——所以青年枢纽在主鱼道之外，另建了一条鳗鱼道。
notes.ex1: Young eels climb damp surfaces rather than leaping between pools. 幼鳗靠贴着潮湿表面攀爬，而不是在水池间跳跃。
notes.ex2: A separate eel pass was built beside the main fish ladder. 在主鱼道旁另建了一条鳗鱼通道。

notes.en: relocate means to move a person, business or object to a new place
notes.ctx: re-（重新）+ locate（定位）；文中指把工程红线内保不住的 9572 株原生红树就近移植到新的适生环境。
notes.ex1: Nearly ten thousand mature trees were relocated rather than cut down. 近万棵成年树被移植而非砍伐。
notes.ex2: The firm relocated its regional office closer to the port. 该公司把区域办公室搬到了离港口更近的地方。

notes.en: a mangrove is a tree that grows in salty coastal water, with roots that rise above the mud
notes.ctx: 长在潮间带咸水里的护岸林，能消浪护堤、又是幼鱼育婴房，极难恢复；文中 9572 株被迁走，另按三倍面积补种 27.5 万株。
notes.ex1: Mangrove forests absorb much of a storm surge before it reaches the shore. 红树林在风暴潮到岸前就消解了大部分能量。
notes.ex2: The team restored thirty hectares of mangrove wetland nearby. 团队在附近修复了三十公顷红树林湿地。

notes.en: offset means to balance one effect against an opposite one so that the overall result is more even
notes.ctx: off（离开）+ set（放置），把一边放到另一边去求平衡；文中指用补种的数十万棵树，抵掉施工对生态的扰动。
notes.ex1: New plantings are meant to offset the damage done during construction. 新种的树林用以抵消施工期间造成的损害。
notes.ex2: Higher volumes helped offset the fall in unit prices. 销量上升有助于抵消单价下滑的影响。

notes.en: disruption means an interruption that stops something from continuing in its normal way
notes.ctx: dis-（分开）+ rupt（断裂），与 interrupt、erupt 同源；文中指施工对当地生态系统的那阵搅扰。
notes.ex1: The works caused temporary disruption to local fishing grounds. 施工对当地渔场造成了暂时的扰动。
notes.ex2: Supply chain disruption pushed delivery times out by three weeks. 供应链中断使交货时间延后了三周。

notes.en: an ecosystem is all the living things in an area together with their physical environment, considered as one connected system
notes.ctx: eco-（居所、生态）+ system（系统）；指彼此依赖、牵一发而动全身的那一整套生物与环境。
notes.ex1: Even a small change in water flow can upset a fragile ecosystem. 水流的微小变化都可能扰乱脆弱的生态系统。
notes.ex2: The group is building a business ecosystem around its logistics platform. 该集团正围绕其物流平台打造商业生态。

paragraphs.en_html: The canal aims to give China’s <mark class="voc">less-prosperous</mark> inland regions quicker and easier access to global sea lanes, <mark class="voc">boosting</mark> local industry and strengthening trade with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean), China’s largest trading partner as a <mark class="voc">bloc</mark>. That ambition is already <mark class="voc">taking shape</mark>. Last Thursday, a <mark class="voc">multimodal</mark> <mark class="voc">freight</mark> train carrying more than 370 tonnes of construction machinery and other products arrived in Guangxi, after <mark class="voc">departing from</mark> Hunan province, with the cargo <mark class="voc">scheduled for</mark> export following the canal’s opening.
paragraphs.zh: 这条运河的用意，是让中国那些不那么富庶的内陆地区，能更快、更便捷地接上全球海运航道，既拉动本地产业，也加深与东盟的贸易往来——作为一个整体，东盟是中国最大的贸易伙伴。而这份雄心，早已不只是纸面文章：上周四，一列多式联运班列自湖南启程抵达广西，载着370多吨工程机械与其他货物，只待运河开航，便可出口。

notes.en: prosperous means successful in economic terms, especially by having money and good business
notes.ctx: 前加 less 是一种克制的委婉——不说 poor，只说“没那么富”；文中指因出海不便而发展受限的西南内陆。
notes.ex1: Coastal provinces remain far more prosperous than inland ones. 沿海省份仍比内陆省份富裕得多。
notes.ex2: Cheaper transport could bring new prosperity to the interior. 更廉价的运输可能为内陆带来新的繁荣。

notes.en: boost means to increase, improve or encourage something, as if pushing it upwards from below
notes.ctx: 本义“从下往上托举”（booster 是助推器）；与第 8 段 spur（马刺，从后面催）正好是一前一后的两种“推”。
notes.ex1: Cheaper logistics should boost exports from the interior. 更低的物流成本应能拉动内陆出口。
notes.ex2: The new terminal gave the port a much-needed boost. 新码头给这座港口带来了一次急需的提振。

notes.en: a bloc is a group of countries that act together as a single unit for political or economic purposes
notes.ctx: 没有 k，别写成 block；文中 as a bloc 是关键限定——单看某一国未必最大，东盟十国合起来才是中国第一大贸易伙伴。
notes.ex1: Negotiating as a bloc gives smaller economies far more leverage. 以集团身份谈判让小经济体拥有大得多的筹码。
notes.ex2: The two blocs signed an upgraded free-trade agreement. 两大集团签署了升级版自贸协定。

notes.en: to take shape means to begin to develop into a clear and recognisable form
notes.ctx: 像陶土在转盘上慢慢显出器形；文中指“雄心”已经落成看得见的事实——班列已到广西等着开航。
notes.ex1: The trade corridor is finally taking shape after years of planning. 经过多年规划，这条贸易通道终于成形。
notes.ex2: Her career took shape only after she moved abroad. 她的事业是在出国之后才真正成形的。

notes.en: multimodal means using more than one method of transport for the same shipment
notes.ctx: multi-（多）+ modal（方式）；同一批货由铁路、公路、水运接力运输，中途不重新装箱。
notes.ex1: Multimodal transport lets cargo switch from rail to ship without repacking. 多式联运让货物从铁路换到轮船时无需重新装箱。
notes.ex2: The new hub was designed to handle multimodal shipments. 这个新枢纽是为处理多式联运货物而设计的。

notes.en: freight means goods transported in bulk, or the business of transporting such goods
notes.ctx: gh 不发音；比 cargo 更侧重“运输这件事”本身，陆运也适用，freight train 即货运列车。
notes.ex1: Rail freight volumes rose sharply ahead of the canal's opening. 运河通航前，铁路货运量大幅上升。
notes.ex2: Air freight is fast but far more expensive than sea freight. 空运快，但比海运贵得多。

notes.en: to depart from a place means to leave it, especially at the start of a journey
notes.ctx: 运输语境里指从某地发车、发船；文中指那列班列自湖南启运、两天后抵达广西。
notes.ex1: The train departed from Hunan and reached Guangxi in two days. 这列火车自湖南发出，两天后抵达广西。
notes.ex2: All services departed on schedule despite the weather. 尽管天气不佳，所有班次仍按时发出。

notes.en: to be scheduled for something means to be arranged or planned to happen at a particular time
notes.ctx: 指日程已排好、只待条件具备即执行；文中那批机械先到、运河后通，说明企业提前押了这张时间表。
notes.ex1: The shipment is scheduled for export as soon as clearance is granted. 这批货已排定，一旦放行即可出口。
notes.ex2: Construction finished three months ahead of schedule. 工程比原计划提前三个月完工。

paragraphs.en_html: The project is also part of a broader push to expand China’s inland waterways, with several other provinces, including Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan and Henan, planning or <mark class="voc">advancing</mark> <mark class="voc">ambitious</mark> <mark class="voc">multibillion-dollar</mark> waterway <mark class="voc">expansions</mark> to boost local economic growth. By using the canal, provinces including Yunnan, Guizhou, Hunan and Sichuan, as well as the <mark class="voc">metropolis</mark> of Chongqing, could <mark class="voc">see their logistics costs</mark> <mark class="voc">reduced by</mark> around 18 per cent to 30 per cent, making it “the shortest, most <mark class="voc">economical</mark> and most convenient route to the sea in the western region”, according to an August 13 report by Yunnan authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工程同时也是中国拓展内河航道这一更大布局中的一环。江西、湖北、湖南、河南等多个省份，都在规划或推进耗资数十亿美元的航道扩建，以此拉动地方经济增长。据云南方面8月13日的一份报告，借助这条运河，云南、贵州、湖南、四川等省以及重庆市的物流成本有望下降约18%至30%，使其成为“西部地区最短、最经济、最便捷的出海通道”。

notes.en: advance means to move forward, or to make progress with a plan or project
notes.ctx: 项目管理语境里指“把工程从规划推向落地”；文中指江西、湖北等省各自在推进航道扩建，进度不一。
notes.ex1: Several provinces are advancing waterway projects of their own. 多个省份正在推进各自的航道工程。
notes.ex2: Payment must be made two weeks in advance. 款项须提前两周支付。

notes.en: ambitious means showing a strong desire to achieve something big, and often requiring great effort
notes.ctx: 褒贬随语境走：说计划是“目标高远”，也常暗含“难度不小、有点过头”的意思。
notes.ex1: The province unveiled an ambitious plan to double its waterway capacity. 该省公布了一项宏大计划，要把航道运力翻一番。
notes.ex2: Analysts said the timeline looked overly ambitious. 分析人士认为这个时间表过于激进。

notes.en: multibillion-dollar means costing or worth several billion dollars
notes.ctx: 复合形容词，单位不加 s；文中指各省航道扩建的投资量级，不是精确数字。
notes.ex1: The group announced a multibillion-dollar investment in port facilities. 该集团宣布对港口设施进行数十亿美元的投资。
notes.ex2: They signed a five-year, multimillion-dollar supply contract. 双方签署了一份为期五年、金额达数百万美元的供货合同。

notes.en: expansion means the process of becoming larger in size, number or scope
notes.ctx: ex-（向外）+ pand（张开）；文中指内河航道的扩建工程——运河是一条，各省的航道网才是那张更大的网。
notes.ex1: The waterway expansion will allow larger barges upstream. 航道扩建将允许更大的驳船上行。
notes.ex2: The firm funded its expansion into Southeast Asia with new debt. 该公司通过举债为其东南亚扩张提供资金。

notes.en: a metropolis is a very large and important city, often the main city of a region
notes.ctx: metro（母）+ polis（城邦），原指古希腊向外殖民时的母城；文中特意不称重庆为 province，因为它是直辖市。
notes.ex1: Chongqing has grown into one of the country's largest inland metropolises. 重庆已发展为中国最大的内陆都市之一。
notes.ex2: The metropolitan area alone accounts for a fifth of regional output. 仅这一个都市圈就占区域产值的五分之一。

notes.en: if a place, a period of time or an organisation sees something happen, that thing happens during it or to it
notes.ctx: 主语并非真在“看”，而是被推到见证者的位置上；用 see 把省份摆到句首，比“成本下降了”更生动。
notes.ex1: The past decade has seen freight costs cut almost in half. 过去十年间，货运成本几乎减半。
notes.ex2: 2026 saw record trade volumes between the two markets. 2026年两个市场之间的贸易额创下纪录。

notes.en: reduce by shows the amount of the decrease; reduce to shows the level that remains after the decrease
notes.ctx: by 是“降了多少”，to 是“降到剩多少”；文中 18%–30% 是降幅，不是降到只剩这么多——一字之差，天差地别。
notes.ex1: Fuel use was reduced by a quarter after the route was shortened. 航线缩短后，燃油消耗减少了四分之一。
notes.ex2: Staff numbers were reduced to 200 following the restructuring. 重组后员工人数减至200人。

notes.en: economical means giving good value in relation to the money, time or resources used
notes.ctx: 与 economic（经济的、与经济有关的）分工明确；文中“最经济”指最省钱，不是“最具经济学意义”。
notes.ex1: Sea transport remains the most economical way to move bulk goods. 海运仍是运输大宗货物最划算的方式。
notes.ex2: The new engine is far more economical on long routes. 新发动机在长途线路上省油得多。

paragraphs.en_html: The canal’s construction has also <mark class="voc">spurred</mark> a broader <mark class="voc">build-out</mark> of supporting infrastructure and transport links. At Nanning Port’s Liujing operations area, <mark class="voc">berths</mark> have been <mark class="voc">upgraded</mark> to handle vessels of up to 5,000 tonnes. The Beibu Gulf Port is also seeking to attract cargo from Chongqing, Sichuan and Yunnan, while <mark class="voc">cross-border</mark> railways such as the China-Laos Railway are expected to <mark class="voc">feed into</mark> the network, according to state media reports.
paragraphs.zh: 运河的建设，还催生了更大范围的配套基建与交通联结。南宁港六景作业区的泊位已完成升级，可停靠5000吨级船舶；北部湾港也在争取重庆、四川、云南的货源。据官方媒体报道，与此同时，中老铁路等跨境铁路预计也将汇入这张运输网。

notes.en: spur means to encourage or cause something to happen more quickly
notes.ctx: 本义“马刺”，骑手用靴跟上的尖轮催马前冲；与 boost（从下面托）不同，spur 是从后面催着往前跑。
notes.ex1: Cheaper freight has spurred investment in riverside industrial parks. 更低的运费带动了沿江工业园区的投资。
notes.ex2: He bought the ticket on the spur of the moment. 他一时冲动买下了那张票。

notes.en: a build-out is the process of constructing or expanding facilities and networks on a large scale
notes.ctx: build out 的名词化，指设施成片铺开；文中指码头升级、港口揽货、铁路对接这一整轮配套建设。
notes.ex1: The canal triggered a rapid build-out of warehouses along its banks. 运河带动了沿岸仓储设施的快速铺开。
notes.ex2: The network build-out will take at least three more years. 这张网络的铺设还需至少三年。

notes.en: a berth is a place in a port where a ship can be tied up and loaded or unloaded
notes.ctx: 本义“给船留出的那个专属位置”；泊位的吨位等级决定港口能接多大的船，所以要跟着运河一起升到 5000 吨级。
notes.ex1: Two deep-water berths were added to handle larger vessels. 新增两个深水泊位以接纳更大船舶。
notes.ex2: Local traders give that supplier a wide berth after the dispute. 那次纠纷之后，当地商户都对这家供应商敬而远之。

notes.en: upgrade means to improve something so that it reaches a higher standard or capacity
notes.ctx: up（向上）+ grade（等级），把承载规格往上提一档；文中指泊位改造到与运河通航标准对齐。
notes.ex1: Berths were upgraded to match the canal's 5,000-tonne standard. 泊位经升级，与运河5000吨级的标准相匹配。
notes.ex2: The rating agency downgraded the operator's credit outlook. 评级机构下调了该运营方的信用展望。

notes.en: cross-border means involving movement or activity between two countries
notes.ctx: 指跨国境开展的运输、贸易、支付；文中指中老铁路这类把中国与东南亚连起来的铁路线。
notes.ex1: Cross-border rail links now carry a growing share of regional freight. 跨境铁路承运的区域货运比重正不断上升。
notes.ex2: Cross-border payments still take two days to settle. 跨境支付结算仍需两天。

notes.en: to feed into something means to flow into it and become part of it, adding to a larger system
notes.ctx: 本义“喂进去”，像支流汇入干流；文中指跨境铁路把货源“喂”进以运河为水运主干的这张网。
notes.ex1: Regional rail lines feed into the main container corridor. 区域铁路线汇入集装箱运输主通道。
notes.ex2: All survey results feed into the final assessment. 所有调查结果都汇入最终评估。

paragraphs.en_html: The opening comes as China’s trade with Asean continues to grow. Beijing has <mark class="voc">increasingly</mark> sought to strengthen <mark class="voc">supply chains</mark> and economic <mark class="voc">ties</mark> with the region as <mark class="voc">tensions</mark> with the West <mark class="voc">persist</mark> over trade and technology. Total trade between China and Asean reached US$862.75 billion in the first eight months of this year, up 25.6 per cent from a year earlier, <mark class="voc">customs</mark> data showed. China’s exports to Asean stood at US$546 billion, up 25.8 per cent. In contrast, exports to the US <mark class="voc">rose</mark> 6.2 per cent <mark class="voc">in dollar terms</mark> over the same period.
paragraphs.zh: 运河通航之时，中国与东盟的贸易仍在持续攀升。在与西方在贸易和技术领域的紧张关系延续的背景下，中国不断加力巩固与这一地区的供应链和经济纽带。海关数据显示，今年前八个月，中国与东盟贸易总额达8627.5亿美元，同比增长25.6%；其中对东盟出口5460亿美元，增长25.8%。相比之下，同期以美元计的对美出口增长6.2%。

notes.en: increasingly means more and more as time passes
notes.ctx: 描述的是程度持续加深的趋势，不是一次性变化；文中指中国对东南亚的经济加码是长期的、在往上走的。
notes.ex1: Regional trade has become increasingly important to both sides. 区域贸易对双方都日益重要。
notes.ex2: Buyers are increasingly sourcing from nearby markets. 买家越来越多地从邻近市场采购。

notes.en: a supply chain is the whole sequence of processes and suppliers involved in producing a product and delivering it to the buyer
notes.ctx: 从原料到成品再到买家手里的整条路径，任何一环卡住则全线受阻；运河就是缩短这条链的物理手段之一。
notes.ex1: Firms are shortening supply chains to reduce delivery risk. 企业正在缩短供应链以降低交付风险。
notes.ex2: The shortage exposed how fragile the supply chain had become. 这次短缺暴露出供应链已变得多么脆弱。

notes.en: ties means the connections or relationships that link two people, groups or countries
notes.ctx: 本义“系上的绳结”（领带 tie 即因系而得名），引申为国与国之间绑在一起的往来；标题里的 trade ties 同此用法。
notes.ex1: The two sides moved to deepen economic ties after the summit. 峰会后双方着手深化经济联系。
notes.ex2: Decades of trade have created close ties between the regions. 数十年的贸易让两地建立起紧密联系。

notes.en: tension means a state of strained relations between people, groups or countries
notes.ctx: 本义“拉紧的状态”；文中指中西方在贸易与技术上的关系一直绷着——这是交代背景，不是本文的主张。
notes.ex1: Trade tensions have pushed firms to diversify their markets. 贸易紧张促使企业分散市场。
notes.ex2: Both sides said they hoped to ease tensions over technology rules. 双方均表示希望缓和在技术规则上的紧张关系。

notes.en: persist means to continue to exist or happen over a period of time
notes.ctx: per-（贯穿始终）+ sist（站立），一直站着不走；文中指那层紧张始终没有消退。
notes.ex1: Shortages persisted well into the second half of the year. 短缺一直延续到下半年。
notes.ex2: She persisted in asking until she got a clear answer. 她一直追问，直到得到明确答复。

notes.en: customs means the government department that collects duties on imports and checks goods entering a country
notes.ctx: 因税项繁多而用复数，注意与 custom（习俗）、customer（顾客）区分；海关数据是全文证据强度最高的一处引用。
notes.ex1: Customs data showed exports rising for a fifth consecutive month. 海关数据显示出口连续第五个月增长。
notes.ex2: Goods were held up at customs for additional checks. 货物因需补充查验而滞留海关。

notes.en: rise (v., intransitive) means to go up by itself; raise (v., transitive) means to move or push something upward
notes.ctx: rise 自己涨、不带宾语，raise 必须有人把它抬上去；文中 exports rose 是出口自身上升，故用不及物的 rose。
notes.ex1: Freight rates rose sharply during the peak season. 旺季期间运价大幅上涨。
notes.ex2: The operator raised fees for oversized containers. 运营方上调了超大集装箱的收费。

notes.en: in dollar terms means when the amount is measured or calculated in US dollars
notes.ctx: 标明计价口径——同一批货，换一种货币算，增速会不一样；文中对美出口 6.2% 是美元口径下的结果。
notes.ex1: Exports rose in dollar terms but fell slightly in volume. 以美元计出口上升，但按量计略有下降。
notes.ex2: Wages grew only marginally in real terms last year. 去年实际工资仅略有增长。

paragraphs.en_html: The opening <mark class="voc">came just ahead of</mark> this year’s China-Asean Expo in Nanning, an annual trade and investment <mark class="voc">fair</mark> showcasing products ranging from <mark class="voc">agricultural</mark> goods and food to machinery and <mark class="voc">hi-tech</mark> equipment.
paragraphs.zh: 运河通航，恰好赶在今年南宁中国—东盟博览会开幕之前——这场一年一度的经贸投资盛会，展品从农产品、食品，一路排到机械与高科技装备。

notes.en: to come ahead of something means to happen shortly before it, often deliberately timed
notes.ctx: just 一词点出“卡点”的意味：9 月 16 日通航、17 日东博会开幕，相隔仅一天，显然是有意安排。
notes.ex1: The announcement came just ahead of the annual industry summit. 这项宣布恰好赶在年度行业峰会之前。
notes.ex2: The line opened three months ahead of schedule. 这条线路比原计划提前三个月开通。

notes.en: a fair is a large public event where companies show and sell their products
notes.ctx: 本义“集市”，商贸语境里指买卖双方集中展示、洽谈的场子；文中即中国—东盟博览会。
notes.ex1: Dozens of new suppliers signed contracts at the trade fair. 数十家新供应商在这场贸易展会上签下合同。
notes.ex2: The job fair attracted more than five thousand applicants. 这场招聘会吸引了五千多名求职者。

notes.en: agricultural means connected with farming and the growing of crops
notes.ctx: agri-（田地）+ culture（耕作）；文中指东博会展品序列的起点——农产品与食品。
notes.ex1: Agricultural goods still make up a large share of the region's exports. 农产品仍占该地区出口的很大比重。
notes.ex2: Faster shipping helps keep agricultural exports fresh on arrival. 更快的运输有助于让农产品到岸时保持新鲜。

notes.en: hi-tech means using the most advanced technology available
notes.ctx: 文中指展品序列的另一端——机械与高科技装备，与农产品一起构成“从土地到实验室”的完整跨度。
notes.ex1: The expo added a dedicated zone for hi-tech equipment this year. 今年展会新设了高科技装备专区。
notes.ex2: The company positions itself at the cutting edge of port automation. 该公司自我定位为港口自动化的最前沿。

proper.name: Gulf of Tonkin / 北部湾（东京湾）
proper.def:
中国与越南之间的半封闭海湾，中国称“北部湾”，国际上通称 Gulf of Tonkin。Tonkin 源自汉字“東京”（越南语 Đông Kinh，意为“东边的京城”，是古代河内的旧称），与日本首都 Tokyo 同源。
本文中的意思：平陆运河的入海口所在，货船由此进入海域、南下东南亚，是这条运河“通江达海”的那个“海”。

proper.name: Pinglu Canal / 平陆运河
proper.def:
位于广西境内的人工运河，全长 134.2 公里，2022 年 8 月开工，2026 年 9 月 16 日正式通航，可通行 5000 吨级船舶。“平陆”二字取自起点南宁横州平塘江口的“平”与终点钦州灵山县陆屋镇的“陆”。
本文中的意思：全文报道的主角，新中国成立以来第一条连接江河与海洋的人工水道。

proper.name: Xinhua News Agency / 新华社
proper.def:
中国国家通讯社，为国内外媒体提供新闻稿件，是中国官方信息的主要发布渠道之一。
本文中的意思：文章中“1949 年以来第一条连接江河与海洋的人工水道”这一说法的信息来源。

proper.name: the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal / 京杭大运河
proper.def:
中国古代最大的水利工程，北起北京、南至杭州，全长近 1800 公里，最早可追溯至春秋时期，隋代大规模贯通，是世界上里程最长的古代人工运河。
本文中的意思：观察人士用来衡量平陆运河分量的历史参照系——把一条刚通航的新运河与它并列，是极高的评价。

proper.name: the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor / 西部陆海新通道
proper.def:
由中国西部省份与广西、云南等沿海沿边地区共建的物流与贸易通道，目标是把中国西部与东南亚及全球市场连接起来，以铁路、公路、海运多式联运为主要形式。
本文中的意思：平陆运河被定位为这条通道中的“关键一环”——它补上了这条通道此前最缺的那段水路。

proper.name: Asean / 东盟（东南亚国家联盟）
proper.def:
由印尼、泰国、越南、马来西亚、新加坡、菲律宾、缅甸、柬埔寨、老挝、文莱十国组成的区域组织，人口逾六亿。自 2020 年起连年为中国第一大贸易伙伴，2025 年中国与东盟双边贸易额首次突破一万亿美元。
本文中的意思：平陆运河缩短出海距离后最直接受益的贸易对象，也是全文经济逻辑的落点——运河的价值，很大程度上取决于南边这个市场有多大。

proper.name: the China-Laos Railway / 中老铁路
proper.def:
连接中国云南昆明与老挝首都万象的跨境铁路，2021 年底建成通车。老挝是内陆国，此前铁路基础极为薄弱，这条线路是其对外货运的主要通道之一。
本文中的意思：文中所举的跨境铁路实例——它把东南亚方向的货源向北输送，预计将与平陆运河所在的水运干线衔接，构成“铁路管陆上、运河管水上”的联运网络。

proper.name: Beibu Gulf Port / 北部湾港
proper.def:
广西沿海港口群的统称，主要包括钦州港、防城港、北海港，是西部陆海新通道的海上门户。
本文中的意思：平陆运河的出海承接方——运河把货运到海边，具体由这个港口群装船出海；文中提到它正积极争取重庆、四川、云南的货源。

proper.name: Nanning Port’s Liujing operations area / 南宁港六景作业区
proper.def:
南宁港下辖的作业区之一，位于郁江沿线，是运河内河段的重要装卸节点。
本文中的意思：配套升级的具体例证——泊位改造后可停靠 5000 吨级船舶，与运河的通航等级相匹配，避免出现“河能过、港靠不了”的短板。

proper.name: the China-Asean Expo / 中国—东盟博览会
proper.def:
自 2004 年起每年在广西南宁举办的大型经贸展会，由中国商务部与东盟各国经贸主管部门、东盟秘书处共同主办。2026 年为第 23 届，于 9 月 17 日至 21 日举行，展览总面积约 17 万平方米。
本文中的意思：运河通航时间点的参照物——运河 9 月 16 日通航，博览会 9 月 17 日开幕，相隔一天；本届展会还专门设有平陆运河展区，把这条刚通航的运河直接摆到全球客商面前。

proper.name: the West / 西方
proper.def:
国际新闻中对欧美等发达经济体的统称，首字母大写时为专有用法，区别于小写的 west（方位词“西方、西边”）。
本文中的意思：文中作为背景交代出现——中国与西方在贸易和技术领域的紧张关系持续存在，这是中国加强与东南亚经贸联系的宏观背景之一。本文仅作事实陈述，未作立场判断。

sources_note: 资料核对：以上背景依据文章内容与南华早报报道，并参考新华社、中国海关总署及广西、云南有关部门的公开数据。

practice.intro: 请将以下中文句子翻译为英文（参考答案见后）。要求：尽量用上本文的核心表达，可以适当改变词形，但不要直接照抄原文。
items: 中国于周三正式让其标志性工程平陆运河通航，为这个国家的西南腹地开辟出一个新的出海门户。
这条水道让内陆省份的货物不必经广州绕行约560公里就能抵达大海，运输时间和物流成本双双下降。
该项目计划投资727亿元人民币（108亿美元），设计上可通行最高5000吨级的船舶，每年可节省超过50亿元的总体运输成本。
这条运河是自1949年中华人民共和国成立以来，建成的第一条连接江河与海洋的人工水道。
在青年枢纽，工程师们修建了一条480多米长、包含120个水池的专用鱼道，帮助水生物种跨越近10米的水位落差。
借助这条运河，云南、贵州、湖南、四川等省份以及重庆市的物流成本可能下降约18%到30%，使其成为“西部地区最短、最经济、最便捷的出海通道”。
practice.critical_en: A canal can shorten a route by 560 kilometres. Can it also shorten the distance between a country and its neighbours?
practice.critical_zh: 一条运河能把航程缩短 560 公里。但它是否也能缩短一个国家与周边国家之间的距离？
practice.answer:
1. China officially opened its landmark Pinglu Canal to navigation on Wednesday, creating a new maritime gateway for the country’s southwestern hinterland.

2. The waterway allows cargo from inland provinces to reach the sea without taking a roughly 560km detour via Guangzhou, cutting both transit times and logistics costs.

3. With a planned investment of 72.7 billion yuan (US$10.8 billion), the project is designed to accommodate vessels of up to 5,000 tonnes and save more than 5 billion yuan in overall transportation costs each year.

4. The canal is the first man-made waterway connecting a river to the sea to be built since the founding of the People’s Republic of China in 1949.

5. At the Qingnian navigation hub, engineers built a dedicated fish passage of more than 480 metres, containing 120 pools, to help aquatic species navigate a water-level difference of nearly 10 metres.

6. By using the canal, provinces including Yunnan, Guizhou, Hunan and Sichuan, as well as the metropolis of Chongqing, could see their logistics costs reduced by around 18 per cent to 30 per cent, making it “the shortest, most economical and most convenient route to the sea in the western region”.
